intro: Merge PDF combines several documents into a single file in the order you decide. It is the quick way to gather the pages of a case file, a quarter's invoices or the chapters of a report before sending them. Everything happens in your browser: files are never uploaded, so it is instant even with confidential documents. You can also paste files straight from the clipboard.

Drag files to reorder them or sort them by name, using natural order so that “doc2” comes before “doc10”. Next to each file there is a box to choose which pages to include, with the same syntax as the other tools: “1-3, 5, 8-”, “even” or “odd”.

More options prepare the result for printing or reading: one bookmark per file to jump between documents, a cover page with the name before each one, a linked table of contents at the start and the file name printed on its pages. If you print double-sided, add a blank page after documents with an odd page count so that every document starts on the front of a sheet.

faq.a: In the browser the limit is your device's memory. With very large documents, try merging them in two batches.
Pages are kept as they are, with their annotations. Each document's original bookmarks are not copied; turn on one bookmark per file if you need them.

faq.q: What if a PDF has a password?
faq.a: Remove it first with Unlock PDF using the open password, then merge it with the rest.
